title: Lemon with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='lemonGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF59D'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#FFE135'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F9C80E'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='lemonShade' cx='70%' cy='75%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#F9C80E' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E0A800' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Lemon body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='38' ry='30' fill='url(#lemonGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='38' ry='30' fill='url(#lemonShade)'/>

  <!-- Lemon nub on left -->
  <ellipse cx='15' cy='55' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#FFE135'/>
  <ellipse cx='15' cy='55' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#E0A800' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- Lemon nub on right -->
  <ellipse cx='85' cy='55' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#FFE135'/>
  <ellipse cx='85' cy='55' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#E0A800' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- Highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='40' rx='14' ry='9' fill='#FFFDE0' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Smiling face -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='50' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#4A3B00'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='50' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#4A3B00'/>
  <!-- Pupils -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='49' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#FFFDE0'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='49' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#FFFDE0'/>

  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='60' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#FF8C42' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='60' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#FF8C42' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M38 62 Q50 74 62 62' stroke='#4A3B00' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Smile highlight -->
  <path d='M42 64 Q50 70 58 64' stroke='#FFFDE0' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
